description: This file defines the FileStreamSourceLog class, which manages logging and recovery for file-based streaming sources in Apache Spark. It handles metadata logging, cache management, batch retrieval, and restoration for streaming file sources.

classes.name: FileStreamSourceLog
classes.description: Manages logging, retrieval, and restoration of file stream source metadata, including cache management and batch handling.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a batch of file entries to the log and updates cache if it's a compaction batch.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves batches of file entries within specified start and end IDs, handling cache and fallback retrieval from compacted logs.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores file entries from existing logs, preloading recent compacted batches into cache for efficient recovery.
